questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Xylem and Flow Controls (including its businesses Cornell Pump Company, Roper Pump Company, Dynamatic, and High Tide Technologies) are close competitors and there are not many alternatives.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Xylem and/or Flow Controls.
